Implemented visual_polish in bob-mac-capture (changes are in the linked repo's working
tree at sase/repos/linked/bob-mac-capture, uncommitted per the plan's cross-phase
constraint against committing/pushing without separate authorization):

- Centralized semantic palette: CaptureSemanticCategory + captureSemanticCategory(forSpanKind:)
  in CaptureCore (Sources/CaptureCore/CompletionRowContent.swift), CaptureEditorPalette
  (Color mapping) in BobMacCapture. Editor highlighting and completion-row accents now
  resolve through the same single palette instead of a duplicated kind->color switch.
- New portable CompletionRowContent view-model in CaptureCore: per-context (route,
  section, pomodoro_block_id, task, wikilink_note, wikilink_heading, wikilink_block) SF
  Symbol, context label, primary/secondary text, case-insensitive match-range emphasis,
  badges, and accessibility label/hint, plus a middleTruncatedPath() helper that
  preserves the basename and truncates the middle of long paths.
- Redesigned CompletionRow/CompletionList in CapturePanelView.swift: two-line rows
  (icon+context label; primary text with bold match emphasis; secondary path truncated
  from the middle plus badges), a category-tinted selected-row fill that raises opacity
  under Increase Contrast, per-row accessibility label+hint, and a list-level
  accessibility label reporting context and result count.
- Removed the now-dead detailText()/color(forSpanKind:) from CapturePanelModel; added
  rowContent(for:) plus completionQueryText() (derives the in-progress query from
  draft/replacement/cursor).
- README.md: new "Wikilink Completion" section (supported forms, alias/heading/block
  insertion, exact caret behavior, row hierarchy, VoiceOver), plus Runtime
  Contract/Privacy/Troubleshooting additions documenting that note metadata is read
  locally by bob and never logged.
- Tests: 21 new CaptureCoreTests (CompletionRowContentTests.swift) covering every
  context, match-range case-insensitivity, and truncation edge cases; 2 new
  BobMacCaptureTests exercising rowContent's end-to-end query derivation via the
  existing fake-bob wikilink/route fixtures.

Verified in this Linux SASE workspace (no Xcode/macOS toolchain available here):
- `swift build --target CaptureCore` and `--target CaptureCoreTests` compile clean.
- Actually EXECUTED (not just type-checked) all 21 CompletionRowContentTests via a
  throwaway local-path SwiftPM harness depending on the CaptureCore product from /tmp
  (discarded afterward) -- all pass. That run caught and I fixed two wrong expectations
  in my own first-draft tests (a byte-offset miscount and a truncation-budget case),
  i.e. real logic verification, not just a syntax check.
- `swift-format lint` on every touched/new file: zero real errors, only the same
  Indentation/LineLength style-warning categories the pre-existing CI-green files
  already produce under this Linux toolchain version (confirmed via a before/after diff
  on the two touched files -- no new warning categories introduced). `git diff --check`
  is clean.
- Could NOT run `just format-lint`/`just build`/`just test`/`just bundle` as a whole
  (BobMacCapture/BobMacCaptureTests require AppKit/SwiftUI on macOS 26) or any manual
  light/dark/increased-contrast/VoiceOver/IME check -- this workspace has no macOS
  toolchain. The phase's "owner-assisted validation gate" still needs to run on a
  physical Mac before this lands; no installed-app, signing, VoiceOver, or IME result is
  claimed here.

title: Future-Pomodoro-link cleanup leaves a dangling trailing newline when the pruned bullet is the file's last line
close_reason: Stale task bead swept from triage.
description:
Discovered while implementing the plan activate_future_scheduled_pomodoro_links.md
(bob-plugins repo, plugins/block-id-prompt/main.js).

listItemSubtreeEdit() (used by planFuturePomodoroLinkCleanup(), called from
completeTaskSourceLink() to prune duplicate future-Pomodoro links) computes the removed
span as [start-of-removed-line, start-of-next-line-or-content.length). This correctly
merges surrounding content when the removed bullet is in the middle of the file, but
when the removed bullet IS the file's last line (no trailing newline after it), the
newline that separated it from the PREVIOUS line is left untouched and nothing follows
to reconnect to, so the file gains a trailing newline it never had.

Repro: a note ending in (no trailing newline)
  - [ ] Later ()
    - [[Alpha#^ship]]
where "[[Alpha#^ship]]" is a dedicated duplicate-link bullet that
planFuturePomodoroLinkCleanup prunes as part of completing a task-picker link elsewhere
in the same Pomodoros section. After pruning, the file ends with
"- [ ] Later ()\n" instead of "- [ ] Later ()" — an unwanted trailing newline introduced
by the cleanup edit.

I worked around this in my own new tests (scripts/test-block-id-prompt.cjs) by ensuring
the pruned bullet is never literally the last line of the fixture, so it did not block
the plan I was implementing. The same subtree-removal shape may exist elsewhere in this
monorepo (e.g. bob-navigation-hotkeys/main.js shares similar list-subtree-removal
helpers) — worth checking during triage whether the same bug is present there too.

title: Remove Swift 6 Sendable warnings from Bob Mac Capture core
description: Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-t.2 during epic verification. On bob-mac-capture master dff08a7, swift build --target CaptureCore succeeds but reports two concurrency diagnostics that become Swift 6 errors: CaptureTargetsCache.swift:39 converts Date.init to an @Sendable closure, and BobProcessClient.swift:189 captures non-Sendable DispatchWorkItem in an @Sendable termination handler. Replace both with race-safe Sendable-compatible designs, add focused tests for injected time and timeout cancellation and one-shot continuation behavior, and verify the CaptureCore build no longer emits either diagnostic.

title: Persist the Bob Mac Capture retained live draft across restarts
close_reason: I'm pretty sure we already did this.
description:
## Feature proposal

Persist the Bob Mac Capture retained live draft so Escape / failed-capture text survives Quit, Restart, crash, and logout.

After https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/pull/1, Control-C canceled drafts write through to `~/Library/Application Support/org.bobs.bob-mac-capture/canceled-draft-stash.json`. The in-editor live draft does not. `CapturePanelModel` still keeps it only in memory (`attributedDraft` / `plainDraft`, plus presentation state such as `errorMessage` and `statusText`). `prepareForRetainedClose()` / `closeRetainingDraft()` set `"Draft retained"` and dismiss the panel; `prepareForPresentation()` reopens that in-memory draft on the next hotkey. `AppDelegate` constructs a fresh `CapturePanelModel` on every launch, so the retained draft is gone after any process exit.

This is a different store from the canceled-draft stash: one current draft (not a bounded newest-first list), restored automatically on next panel open rather than through Control-S, and discarded by **Discard** / Control-C / successful capture rather than by Clear Stash. The approved persist-stash plan named this as out of scope and asked for a follow-up task bead rather than folding it into that PR.

### Evidence

- `Sources/BobMacCapture/CapturePanelModel.swift` — `prepareForRetainedClose()`, `closeRetainingDraft()`, `prepareForPresentation()`, and `discardDraft()` operate only on in-memory published state. There is no encode, decode, or file I/O.
- Tests `testEscapeClosesOnceAndRetainsNonemptyDraft` and `testEscapeDismissesCompletionBeforeClosingPanel` assert in-process retention only.
- PR-branch README Privacy still says captured text lives only in the panel's in-memory draft (plus the new on-disk stash for Control-C). A live-draft persist would be a second documented-guarantee change, same class of README/Settings rewrite the stash work required.

### Suggested shape (not a plan)

Mirror the stash store: Foundation-only CaptureCore JSON file under the same 0700 Application Support directory, write-through on retain/discard/success, delete the file when the live draft is empty, metadata-only errors, never interpolate draft text. Do not persist completion candidates, preview payloads, or diagnostics that are not needed to reopen the editor exactly as left. Confirm with the owner whether a failed capture's `errorMessage` should survive relaunch.

Work is in the `bob-mac-capture` linked repo. Linux can type-check CaptureCore only; macOS CI is the real gate.

Plan that scoped this out: `plan:202608/persist_canceled_draft_stash.md`.

task_type_fields.proposal: Persist the Bob Mac Capture in-editor retained live draft (Escape / failed capture) across Quit, Restart, crash, and logout. This is a single-draft store restored on the next panel open, not the Control-C canceled-draft stash.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved persist-canceled-draft-stash plan (and PR bobs-org/bob-mac-capture#1) explicitly left this out: it is a different store with different semantics (one current draft, not a bounded list; auto-restore on panel open, not Control-S). The user asked about the stash. Do not fold this into that PR.
